note: Canon Warhammer sea groups for the hand-drawn sea zones (board #2698). Each canon sea is located by guaranteed-interior water SEED PIXELS in provinces.png canvas space (x, y), read off the sea names printed on tools/derived/seas_partition_review.png (the Terraqueous globe with the user's purple zone boundaries). worldgen.sea_naming.assign grows a wrap-aware seed-Voronoi over the water mask and gives each zone the canon sea owning the plurality of its pixels; the per-zone key is STATE_<name>_NN. `overrides` reassign a single mis-assigned zone to a different canon sea, keyed on an interior pixel of THAT zone (never a label id). Authored order is the deterministic canon-index tie-break (a plurality tie goes to the earlier sea) — do not reorder casually. Hand-authored geographic data like tools/config/inland_lakes.json: edit deliberately, then regenerate through generate_sea_zones.py; never infer from a bitmap. `merges` fuse several zones into one standalone-named province (its own name, not a canon-sea NN slot) and can flag the result impassable; `impassable_seeds` flags an ordinary zone impassable without renaming or merging it. The 2026-08-22 'no impassable sea province' decision (1800s steamships cross open ocean) stands as the DEFAULT; these are the 2026-08-31 exceptions the user named during the naming pass — a supernatural whirlpool (Maelstrom) and open-water expanses the user wants unsailable for other reasons.
